h2. Problem

Nightly export to the data warehouse fails with a *timeout* after the _October_ schema change. Reported by [~jdoe] in the ops channel.

h2. Steps

# Trigger the job from [Jenkins|https://jenkins.imagile.dev/job/warehouse-export/]
# Wait for the {{extract}} stage
#* It hangs at 63%
#* The worker logs show the query below
# Kill the job after 30 minutes

{code:sql}
SELECT o.id, o.total, c.region
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.updated_at > :since;
{code}

h3. Affected tables

||Table||Rows||Index on updated_at||
|orders|48,200,113|no|
|customers|1,902,554|yes|

{panel:title=Workaround}
Run the export with {{--since}} set to yesterday; it finishes in about 12 minutes.
{panel}

bq. Adding the index needs a maintenance window: -approved for Saturday- pending DBA sign-off.

{color:red}Do not{color} rerun the full backfill without checking disk space first.

Screenshot of the stuck stage: !stage-hang.png|thumbnail!
